scope: Statically traced EQ HUI registration and MIDI-adapter dispatch. Not yet a verified live injection contract.

registration.lookup: ID modulo signed bucket count at registry+24; bucket table at +8; node key+0, value+8, next+16. Reader counter is acquired/released atomically.
registration.subscriber: owner+0x30 (or null), passed to resolved component virtual +0x30 with w2=1
registration.failure: Missing registry entry returns false; caller emits named linkToObserver diagnostic.

arguments.x3: pointer to payload: float32 at+0 and 32-bit field at+4

observer.delivery: listener virtual slot8 (+0x40), x1=identifier, s0=float, w2=payload+4. Skip default no-op 0x6cb490.

adapter.behavior: Maps incoming HUI ID through object hash table (+0x20 table, +0x28 bucket count) to operation ID. Zero mapped ID returns without notification.
adapter.missing_id: Allocates 24-byte node with zero mapped value, so this entry is not allocation-free.
adapter.special_case: Mapped ID 0x01441c7d60cec880: field==255 drops; otherwise substitutes 0x01bfa71818497e99. Meaning not assigned.
adapter.downstream: Listener vector object+8/+16; virtual slot5 (+0x28) receives mapped operation ID, unchanged float and 32-bit field.

unresolved: Live initialized registry/component ownership and lifetime.
Actual EQ float range/adapter configuration. Generic HuiSlider trace identifies second field as raw input uint32 at+8; see az-slider-value-contract.json.
Which current listeners are registered and whether the EQ operation mapping is enabled.
Hardware TX mode connection and software mixer EQ1 synchronization.
integration_constraints: Do not call callback with full owner where slider subobject is required.
Do not treat the adapter operation ID as the original HUI ID.
Do not place allocation-capable dispatch on the audio callback.
Do not claim native EQ audio follows these events until runtime and mixer output are verified.
